marquee.text: Founded by Late Nazar Hussain Alvi
Main Campus: Qila Didar Singh Gujranwala

founder.name: Nazar Hussain Alvi
founder.title: Late Founder & Visionary Patron
founder.urduTitle: بانیِ ادارہ: محترم نذر حسین علوی (مرحوم)
founder.quote: Serving humanity in distress is the highest form of worship. Our doors must always remain open to the needy.
founder.bio: The benevolent founder whose compassion and devotion laid the cornerstone of Ali Welfare Trust Hospital in 2005, ensuring that no patient in Qila Didar Singh and surrounding villages is ever denied world-class healthcare due to lack of funds.

memorialPillars.title: Foundation of Compassion (2005)
memorialPillars.desc: Established with a solemn pledge that financial constraints should never prevent a human being from receiving dignified healthcare.

memorialPillars.title: Free Dialysis & Eye Care Legacy
memorialPillars.desc: Pioneered community welfare health camps, subsidized dialysis programs, and free cataract eye surgeries across Gujranwala district.

memorialPillars.title: Perpetual Sadqah-e-Jariyah
memorialPillars.desc: Operating purely on non-profit principles with transparent zakat governance and audited community trust accountability.

executiveTeam.name: Nazar Hussain Alvi
executiveTeam.title: Late Founder & Visionary Patron
executiveTeam.bio: The benevolent founder whose compassion and devotion laid the cornerstone of Ali Welfare Trust Hospital in 2005, ensuring that no patient in Qila Didar Singh and surrounding villages is ever denied world-class healthcare due to lack of funds.
executiveTeam.quote: Serving humanity in distress is the highest form of worship. Our doors must always remain open to the needy.

executiveTeam.name: Zamin Ali Alvi
executiveTeam.title: Chairman & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
executiveTeam.bio: Under his dynamic executive leadership, the hospital has expanded into a multi-specialty institution featuring state-of-the-art dialysis suites, digital radiology, advanced eye care theater, and free medicine distribution programs.
executiveTeam.quote: Our relentless commitment is to blend clinical excellence with heartfelt empathy for every single patient.

executiveTeam.name: Khawar Abbas Awan
executiveTeam.title: Hospital Director
executiveTeam.bio: Spearheading administrative operational excellence, welfare outreach programs, community health camps, and modern infrastructure enhancements across all inpatient and outpatient departments.
executiveTeam.quote: Every donation and every effort is dedicated transparently towards saving human lives and alleviating pain.

mission.missionEn: To provide accessible and compassionate healthcare, ensuring high-quality medical services for our community, regardless of circumstances.
mission.missionUrdu: معاشرے کے ہر فرد کو بلا تفریق معیاری، سستی اور ہمدردانہ طبی سہولیات کی فراہمی
mission.visionEn: To be a leading healthcare institution known for excellence in patient care and community service, creating a healthier society through innovation and empowerment.
mission.visionUrdu: صحت عامہ میں جدت، بہترین نگہداشت اور بے لوث خدمت کے ذریعے ایک صحت مند معاشرے کی تشکیل

pillars.title: Compassionate Care
pillars.desc: Treating every patient with dignity, warmth, and clinical sensitivity regardless of socioeconomic standing.

pillars.title: Clinical Excellence
pillars.desc: Modern diagnostic imaging, international sterilization protocols, and qualified medical specialists.

pillars.title: Transparent Welfare
pillars.desc: Every rupee of Zakat and Sadqah directly utilized for patient treatments, dialysis sessions, and free medicine.

departments.name: General Physician & OPD
departments.urduName: جنرل فزیشن و او پی ڈی کلینک
departments.shortDesc: Daily General Physician clinical consultations for fevers, infections, diabetes, blood pressure, and adult illnesses.
departments.fullDesc: Our General Physician department offers compassionate, expert primary healthcare. From routine health assessments to management of chronic hypertension, diabetes, gastrointestinal and seasonal infections, qualified medical officers and senior physicians are on duty daily.
departments.headDoctor: Dr. Sheraz Ul Hassan Chathha (General Physician)

departments.name: Ultrasound & Color Doppler
departments.shortDesc: High-resolution 4D Ultrasound, Color Doppler scans, Digital X-Rays, and immediate imaging reports.
departments.fullDesc: State-of-the-art Ultrasound and diagnostic imaging wing equipped with multi-frequency probes for abdominal, pelvic, obstetrics/pregnancy 3D/4D scans, vascular color doppler, and digital X-rays operated by qualified sonologists and radiologists.

departments.name: Laboratory for Blood Tests
departments.urduName: لیبارٹری برائے خون کے ٹیسٹ و تشخیص
departments.shortDesc: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Blood Sugar, LFT, RFT, Lipid Profile, and 24/7 automated blood testing.
departments.fullDesc: Comprehensive clinical diagnostic laboratory offering precision hematology, biochemistry, and serology. Automated blood analyzers provide rapid, accurate testing for emergency blood counts, cardiac enzymes, viral hepatitis screening, and organ profiles.
features: Hepatitis B & C Rapid & ELISA Screening
Free & Subsidized Blood Tests for Needy Patients

departments.name: Kidney Dialysis Center
departments.shortDesc: Advanced German-standard hemodialysis machines delivering free & subsidized life-saving renal care.
departments.fullDesc: Our dedicated Kidney Dialysis Unit provides round-the-clock hemodialysis supervised by experienced nephrologists and certified dialysis technicians. Complete with dedicated water treatment plant, strict sterilization protocols, and emergency backup.
features: Dedicated Hepatitis B & C Separate Units

departments.name: Eye Care & Ophthalmology
departments.shortDesc: Modern phaco cataract surgeries, computer vision testing, and cornea diagnostics.
departments.fullDesc: Equipped with state-of-the-art ophthalmic surgical microscopes, phacoemulsification systems, auto-refractometers, and slit lamps. We organize frequent free cataract surgery camps for rural elderly citizens.
features: Free Lens Implantation for Needy Patients

departments.name: Gynecology & Obstetrics
departments.shortDesc: Safe deliveries, prenatal and postnatal maternal care, and female reproductive health.
departments.fullDesc: Dedicated labor rooms, modern neonatal resuscitation setup, experienced female gynecologists and trained lady health visitors ensuring safe child delivery and respectful mother-infant care.

departments.name: 24/7 Emergency & Trauma
departments.shortDesc: Rapid response trauma unit with oxygen manifold, cardiac monitors, and resuscitation beds.
departments.fullDesc: Uninterrupted 24/7 trauma and acute care reception capable of stabilizing accidents, cardiac crises, acute respiratory failure, and medical emergencies immediately upon arrival.

departments.name: In-House Welfare Pharmacy
departments.shortDesc: Quality certified medicines available 24/7, with subsidized and free medicine dispensation.
departments.fullDesc: Clean, temperature-controlled pharmacy stocking 100% authentic pharmaceuticals directly from approved manufacturers. Free medication dispensed to eligible needy patients on doctor prescription.

departments.name: Ear, Nose & Throat (ENT)
departments.shortDesc: Comprehensive diagnostics and treatments for ear infections, sinus conditions, and throat disorders.
departments.fullDesc: Equipped with modern diagnostic otoscopes, audiometry screening, and specialized ENT clinic offering patient-first solutions for hearing, nasal breathing, and throat health.

departments.name: Orthopaedics & Family Medicine
departments.shortDesc: Joint pain, fractures, arthritis management, and full-spectrum family healthcare.
departments.fullDesc: Dedicated orthopaedic and family medicine consultation offering advanced bone, joint, and spine evaluations alongside everyday medical triage for all family members.

departments.name: Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation
departments.shortDesc: Targeted physical rehabilitation for stroke recovery, chronic joint pain, and mobility restoration.
departments.fullDesc: Modern physiotherapy unit equipped with ultrasonic therapy, TENS, cervical-lumbar traction, and tailored kinesiology exercise regimens under expert physiotherapist supervision.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Child Healthcare
departments.urduName: شعبہ اطفال و نگہداشتِ نو مولود
departments.shortDesc: Comprehensive infant, child, and adolescent healthcare, growth monitoring, and immunization.
departments.fullDesc: Gentle and compassionate pediatric care focusing on newborn health, childhood infections, nutritional advice, vaccination, and developmental screening.

doctors.name: Dr. Eman Salman
doctors.profile: Dr. Eman Salman is a distinguished Consultant Gynaecologist specializing in comprehensive maternal-fetal care, high-risk obstetric management, antenatal triage, and gynecological disorder therapeutics. Dedicated to providing respectful, evidence-based reproductive healthcare at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), Member of Society of Obstetricians & Gynaecologists
doctors.experience: Consultant Specialist in Maternal Health & Advanced Gynecological Medicine

doctors.name: Dr. Saqib Jalil
doctors.profile: Dr. Saqib Jalil is an esteemed Otolaryngology (ENT) Specialist offering advanced clinical diagnostics and therapeutic protocols for hearing impairments, chronic sinusitis, nasal airway obstructions, vertigo, and throat pathologies at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS / MS (Oto-Rhino-Laryngology), Certified Head & Neck Specialist
doctors.experience: Senior Consultant in Clinical Otolaryngology & ENT Surgical Care

doctors.name: Dr. Zeeshan Saeed
doctors.profile: Dr. Zeeshan Saeed is an accomplished Kidney Transplant Physician and Nephrologist with focused expertise in renal replacement therapies, pre- and post-kidney transplant immunosuppression oversight, glomerulonephritis, and advanced hemodialysis management at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS (Nephrology), Fellowship in Renal Transplantation & Hemodialysis
doctors.experience: Specialist Consultant in Kidney Transplantation & Chronic Renal Care

doctors.name: Dr. Usama Saeed
doctors.profile: Dr. Usama Saeed provides high-level clinical management spanning orthopaedic trauma, degenerative joint disorders, spinal alignment, fracture immobilization, as well as comprehensive primary family medicine across all age groups at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.experience: Dual-Certified Consultant in Orthopaedic Surgery & Primary Family Healthcare

doctors.name: Dr. Amara Anwar
doctors.profile: Dr. Amara Anwar is an expert Physiotherapist directing customized neurological and musculoskeletal rehabilitation programs, post-trauma recovery, electrotherapy, and ergonomic spinal decompression regimens at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: DPT (Doctor of Physical Therapy), Certified Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation Practitioner
doctors.experience: Clinical Specialist in Physical Therapy & Neuro-Muscular Rehabilitation

doctors.name: Dr. Syed Jawad Haider
doctors.profile: Dr. Syed Jawad Haider is an eminent Consultant Neuro Surgeon offering expert tertiary consultations for cranial traumas, cerebral pathologies, spinal disc herniations, cervical cord compression, and peripheral neuropathy at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS (Neurosurgery), Fellowship in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery
doctors.experience: Tertiary Consultant Neurosurgeon & Spinal Reconstruction Specialist

doctors.name: Dr.Sheraz Ul Hassan Chathha
doctors.profile: Dr. Sheraz Ul Hassan Chathha is a dedicated General Physician providing clinical triage, infectious disease protocols, cardiovascular and metabolic wellness diagnostics, and acute illness management at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.experience: Experienced Medical Specialist in Clinical Diagnostics & Adult Medicine

doctors.name: Dr. Jamshed Ahmed Cheema
doctors.profile: Dr. Jamshed Ahmed Cheema is a leading Pulmonologist and Chest Specialist treating chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), bronchial asthma, pulmonary infections, chronic cough, and post-pneumonia complications at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.experience: Senior Respiratory Medicine Consultant & Bronchial Disease Expert

doctors.name: Dr. Salman Khalid
doctors.profile: Dr. Salman Khalid is a compassionate Child Specialist delivering expert neonatal care, infant nutrition counseling, pediatric infectious disease therapy, immunization schedules, and developmental milestones monitoring at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.

doctors.name: Dr. Amir Sohail
doctors.profile: Dr. Amir Sohail is a seasoned Eye Physician offering comprehensive computerized refractive assessments, glaucoma management, diabetic retinopathy evaluations, and anterior segment diagnostics at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.experience: Specialist Consultant in Clinical Ophthalmology & Refractive Health

doctors.name: Dr. Malik Muhammad Arfan
doctors.profile: Dr. Malik Muhammad Arfan is an expert Gastroenterologist providing cutting-edge management for acid peptic disease, hepatitis B and C, fatty liver disease, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and chronic digestive ailments at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS (Gastroenterology & Hepatology), Member of Pakistan Society of Gastroenterology
doctors.experience: Senior Specialist in Digestive Disorders, Liver Diseases & Endoscopy

doctors.name: Dr. Ali Raza
doctors.profile: Dr. Ali Raza is an experienced General Surgeon delivering operative evaluations, surgical interventions for abdominal emergencies, hernia repairs, diabetic foot salvage, wound debridement, and comprehensive post-operative inpatient care at Ali Welfare Trust Hospital.
doctors.qualification: MBBS, FCPS (General Surgery), Certified in Laparoscopic Surgery
doctors.experience: Consultant General Surgeon with High Operative Precision & Trauma Expertise

banner.headline: Ali Welfare Trust Hospital
banner.appealEnglish: Help us save precious human lives through free hemodialysis sessions, subsidized medicines, and free cataract surgeries for the impoverished.
banner.appealUrdu: مستحق اور نادار مریضوں کے علاج اور ادویات کے لیے دل کھول کر عطیات دیں

bank.appealUrdu: مستحق اور نادار مریضوں کے علاج اور ادویات کے لیے دل کھول کر عطیات دیں
bank.appealEnglish: Please donate generously to support life-saving kidney dialysis, eye surgeries, and free medical aid for poor and needy patients.

causes.title: Sponsor a Dialysis Session
causes.urduTitle: ایک مریض کا ڈائلیسز سیشن سپانسر کریں
causes.description: Provide a life-saving hemodialysis session including dialyzer, heparin, saline, and specialist nursing for a poor renal patient.
causes.impactNote: 1 dialysis session extends a kidney patient's life by 3 to 4 days.

causes.title: Free Eye Cataract Surgery (Phaco)
causes.description: Restore sight for an elderly grandmother or grandfather with stitchless phacoemulsification and imported intraocular lens.
causes.impactNote: Restores clear eyesight and independence for life.

causes.title: Patient Free Medicine Fund
causes.urduTitle: غریب مریضوں کی مفت ادویات کا فنڈ
causes.description: Support monthly life-saving heart, diabetes, and antibiotic treatments for patients who cannot afford pharmacy bills.
causes.impactNote: Supplies essential prescription medicines for an entire month.

causes.title: 24/7 Emergency & Ambulance Fund
causes.description: Fund life-saving oxygen cylinders, emergency trauma resuscitation kits, and rapid rural patient transfers.
causes.impactNote: Keeps rapid response ambulances fueled and ready 24/7.

aiSettings.welcomePrayerMessage: Peace be upon you, Sir. I am Ali Care, your 24/7 dedicated AI Consultant for Ali Welfare Trust Hospital. I can schedule specialist appointments, answer any medical or general question from the internet, guide your Zakat & Sadqah donations, provide appointment reminders, and connect emergency calls. How may I serve you today, Sir?
aiSettings.welcomeUrduMessage: السلام علیکم محترم جناب! میں علی کیئر ہوں، علی ویلفیئر ٹرسٹ ہسپتال کا 24/7 ذہین اے آئی کنسلٹنٹ۔ میں ڈاکٹرز کے معائنے کا وقت، عطیات، یاد دہانی اور انٹرنیٹ سے تمام معلومات فراہم کر سکتا ہوں۔ فرمائیے میں آپ کی کیا خدمت کر سکتا ہوں؟
aiSettings.customSystemInstructions: You are Ali Care, the 24/7 intelligent, respectful AI healthcare consultant and problem solver for Ali Welfare Trust Hospital, Qila Didar Singh. Always address users politely as Sir or Respected Sir/Madam.
suggestedQuestions: Book an appointment with specialist doctor
Meezan Bank Zakat & Sadqah donation details
Call emergency desk or ambulance now
Ask any general medical or internet question
